---

```{r}
# =========================
# Cumulative DOC removal in serial bioreactors
# =========================

# ---- packages ----
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(glue)
library(forcats)

# ---- parameters ----
data_path <- "~/github/sbc_bioreactors/data/bioreactor_data.xlsx"
target_exps <- c(
  "BR15-4", "BR15-10", "BR15-11", "BR16-2",
  "BR16-3", "BR17-1", "BR17-2"
)

# In this dataset, flow rate is stored in mL s^-1.
# Thus, 0.066667 mL s^-1 = 4 mL min^-1 and 0.333 mL s^-1 = 20 mL min^-1.
# Retain only the 4 mL min^-1 treatment for BR15-4.
flow_4_ml_min <- 4 / 60
flow_tolerance <- 0.001

analytical_threshold <- 1.5  # µmol C L^-1
fig_out <- "figures/Figure_4_serial_DOC_removal.pdf"
csv_out <- "results/Figure_4_serial_DOC_removal_summary.csv"

# ---- load and clean ----
df <- read_excel(data_path, sheet = 1) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    bioreactor_n  = as.numeric(bioreactor_n),
    hours_elapsed = as.numeric(hours_elapsed),
    flowrate      = as.numeric(flowrate),
    trt            = fct_explicit_na(as.factor(trt), na_level = "unspecified"),
    beads          = fct_explicit_na(as.factor(beads), na_level = "unspecified")
  )

# Keep serial-assay observations only. For BR15-4, exclude the 20 mL min^-1
# treatment so that all panels represent approximately 4 mL min^-1 assays.
df_sub <- df |>
  filter(exp %in% target_exps) |>
  filter(
    exp != "BR15-4" |
      is.na(flowrate) |
      abs(flowrate - flow_4_ml_min) <= flow_tolerance
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(bioreactor_n)) |>
  mutate(
    treatment_label = case_when(
      trt == "DiatomLysate" ~ "diatom lysate",
      trt == "0m"           ~ "ambient",
      TRUE                  ~ as.character(trt)
    ),
    bead_label = case_when(
      beads == "homogenous" ~ "Homogeneous (1 mm)",
      beads == "mixed"      ~ "Mixed (1 + 4 mm)",
      TRUE                  ~ as.character(beads)
    )
  )

# ---- define independent serial configurations ----
# The bioreactor field records the columns in each configuration (e.g., 1_2_3).
# The first column number identifies the independent serial sequence.
df_sub <- df_sub |>
  mutate(
    first_column = if_else(
      bioreactor_n > 0 & !is.na(bioreactor),
      stringr::str_extract(as.character(bioreactor), "^[0-9]+"),
      NA_character_
    ),
    series_id = case_when(
      bioreactor_n == 0 ~ "influent",
      !is.na(first_column) ~ paste0("series_", first_column),
      TRUE ~ as.character(bioreactor)
    )
  )

# ---- panel labels ----
# Combine bead packings within the same experiment panel and distinguish them
# by color. BR16-3 remains separated by treatment.
df_sub <- df_sub |>
  mutate(
    panel = case_when(
      exp == "BR16-3" ~ paste(exp, treatment_label, sep = " – "),
      TRUE ~ exp
    )
  )

# Influent samples do not carry bead-packing labels, so duplicate the appropriate
# influent into every panel belonging to the same experiment/treatment.
panel_key <- df_sub |>
  filter(bioreactor_n > 0) |>
  distinct(exp, treatment_label, panel)

influent <- df_sub |>
  filter(bioreactor_n == 0) |>
  group_by(exp, treatment_label) |>
  slice_min(hours_elapsed, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  summarise(doc_in = mean(mean_doc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(panel_key, by = c("exp", "treatment_label")) |>
  select(panel, doc_in)

# ---- cumulative removal for each independent serial configuration ----
series_data <- df_sub |>
  filter(bioreactor_n > 0, !is.na(mean_doc)) |>
  select(
    exp, treatment_label, panel, bead_label, series_id,
    bioreactor, bioreactor_n, mean_doc
  ) |>
  left_join(influent, by = "panel") |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_removal = doc_in - mean_doc,
    pct_removed = 100 * cumulative_removal / doc_in
  ) |>
  arrange(panel, series_id, bioreactor_n) |>
  group_by(panel, bead_label, series_id) |>
  mutate(
    marginal_removal = cumulative_removal - lag(cumulative_removal),
    marginal_class = case_when(
      is.na(marginal_removal) ~ "first column",
      marginal_removal >= analytical_threshold ~ "resolvable additional removal",
      marginal_removal <= -analytical_threshold ~ "decline in cumulative removal",
      TRUE ~ "change below analytical resolution"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# ---- panel summaries ----
# Where more than one independent serial configuration is available at a given
# position (BR15-4), report arithmetic mean ± SD among configurations.
# Single-configuration panels are shown without an error bar.
summary_data <- series_data |>
  group_by(panel, bead_label, bioreactor_n) |>
  summarise(
    mean_removal = mean(cumulative_removal, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_removal = if_else(n() > 1, sd(cumulative_removal, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    n_series = n_distinct(series_id),
    mean_pct_removed = mean(pct_removed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(panel, bioreactor_n) |>
  group_by(panel, bead_label) |>
  mutate(
    marginal_mean = mean_removal - lag(mean_removal),
    marginal_class = case_when(
      is.na(marginal_mean) ~ "first column",
      marginal_mean >= analytical_threshold ~ "resolvable additional removal",
      marginal_mean <= -analytical_threshold ~ "decline in cumulative removal",
      TRUE ~ "change below analytical resolution"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# ---- facet order ----
panel_order <- c(
  "BR15-4",
  "BR15-10",
  "BR15-11",
  "BR16-2",
  "BR16-3 – ambient",
  "BR16-3 – diatom lysate",
  "BR17-1",
  "BR17-2"
)

series_data <- series_data |>
  mutate(
    panel = factor(panel, levels = panel_order),
    bead_label = factor(
      bead_label,
      levels = c("Homogeneous (1 mm)", "Mixed (1 + 4 mm)")
    )
  )
summary_data <- summary_data |>
  mutate(
    panel = factor(panel, levels = panel_order),
    bead_label = factor(
      bead_label,
      levels = c("Homogeneous (1 mm)", "Mixed (1 + 4 mm)")
    )
  )

panel_labeller <- labeller(
  panel = function(x) {
    x |>
      stringr::str_remove("^BR") |>
      stringr::str_replace(" – ambient$", "\nambient") |>
      stringr::str_replace(" – diatom lysate$", "\ndiatom lysate")
  }
)

# A zero-column reference is useful because cumulative removal is exactly zero
# before water enters a bioreactor. These origin points are definitional, not
# measured observations, and are plotted in grey without entering summaries.
show_origin <- TRUE
origin_data <- summary_data |>
  distinct(panel) |>
  mutate(
    bioreactor_n = 0,
    mean_removal = 0
  )

# ---- figure ----
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey65") +
  # Optional definitional origin: zero cumulative removal at zero columns.
  {if (show_origin) geom_point(
    data = origin_data,
    aes(x = bioreactor_n, y = mean_removal),
    shape = 23,
    size = 2.0,
    stroke = 0.55,
    fill = "white",
    color = "grey45",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )} +
  # Independent serial configurations.
  geom_line(
    data = series_data,
    aes(
      x = bioreactor_n,
      y = cumulative_removal,
      group = interaction(panel, bead_label, series_id),
      color = bead_label
    ),
    linewidth = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.30,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = series_data,
    aes(
      x = bioreactor_n,
      y = cumulative_removal,
      color = bead_label
    ),
    size = 1.7,
    alpha = 0.40,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Arithmetic mean ± SD among independent serial configurations.
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data |> filter(!is.na(sd_removal)),
    aes(
      x = bioreactor_n,
      ymin = mean_removal - sd_removal,
      ymax = mean_removal + sd_removal,
      color = bead_label
    ),
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.55,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.08),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = bioreactor_n,
      y = mean_removal,
      group = bead_label,
      color = bead_label
    ),
    linewidth = 0.90
  ) +
  # First-column symbols are filled by bead configuration; subsequent
  # marginal-change symbols remain open to emphasize the change category.
  geom_point(
    data = summary_data |> filter(marginal_class == "first column"),
    aes(
      x = bioreactor_n,
      y = mean_removal,
      shape = marginal_class,
      color = bead_label,
      fill = bead_label
    ),
    size = 2.9,
    stroke = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_data |> filter(marginal_class != "first column"),
    aes(
      x = bioreactor_n,
      y = mean_removal,
      shape = marginal_class,
      color = bead_label
    ),
    size = 2.9,
    stroke = 0.75,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Homogeneous (1 mm)" = "#009E73",
      "Mixed (1 + 4 mm)" = "#E69F00"
    ),
    name = "Bead configuration"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Homogeneous (1 mm)" = "#009E73",
      "Mixed (1 + 4 mm)" = "#E69F00"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "first column" = 22,
      "resolvable additional removal" = 24,
      "change below analytical resolution" = 21,
      "decline in cumulative removal" = 25
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "first column",
      "resolvable additional removal",
      "change below analytical resolution",
      "decline in cumulative removal"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "First column",
      expression(paste(">=1.5 ", mu, "mol C ", L^{-1}, " additional removal")),
      expression(paste("<1.5 ", mu, "mol C ", L^{-1}, " change")),
      "Decline in cumulative removal"
    ),
    name = "Marginal change"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:5,
    limits = c(-0.15, 5.2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of bioreactor columns in series",
    y = expression("Cumulative DOC removal ("*mu*"mol C L"^{-1}*")"),
    # caption = paste0(
    #   "Colors distinguish bead configurations. Small points and thin lines show independent serial configurations; ",
    #   "large points show arithmetic means. Error bars show SD among independent serial configurations where more than one was available. ",
    #   if (show_origin) "Grey diamonds at zero columns are definitional origins (zero cumulative removal), not measured samples. " else "",
    #   "Symbol shapes classify the marginal change relative to the preceding measured column using a 1.5 µmol C L⁻¹ analytical threshold. ",
    #   "BR15-4 includes only the 4 mL min⁻¹ treatment."
    # )
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 2.6, linewidth = 0.8)
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(color = "black", fill = "white", size = 2.6)
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3, labeller = panel_labeller) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.0, "lines"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 10, 6, 6)
  )

p

ggsave(
  filename = fig_out,
  plot = p,
  width = 10.5,
  height = 7.8,
  dpi = 600
)


# ---- tidy output table ----
table_ms <- series_data |>
  transmute(
    experiment = exp,
    treatment = treatment_label,
    panel,
    bead_packing = bead_label,
    series_id,
    configuration = bioreactor,
    position = bioreactor_n,
    influent_doc_uM = round(doc_in, 2),
    effluent_doc_uM = round(mean_doc, 2),
    cumulative_removal_uM = round(cumulative_removal, 2),
    percent_removed = round(pct_removed, 1),
    marginal_removal_uM = round(marginal_removal, 2),
    marginal_class
  ) |>
  arrange(panel, series_id, position)

# ---- concise panel summary ----
summary_text <- summary_data |>
  group_by(panel, bead_label) |>
  summarise(
    max_position = max(bioreactor_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_removal_uM = round(max(mean_removal, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    position_of_maximum = bioreactor_n[which.max(mean_removal)],
    additional_removal_beyond_column_2 = any(
      bioreactor_n > 2 & marginal_mean >= analytical_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    note = if_else(
      additional_removal_beyond_column_2,
      glue(
        "Resolvable additional removal occurred beyond column 2; maximum mean removal was {maximum_removal_uM} µM at position {position_of_maximum}."
      ),
      glue(
        "No mean increment beyond column 2 exceeded 1.5 µM; maximum mean removal was {maximum_removal_uM} µM at position {position_of_maximum}."
      )
    )
  )

if (!is.null(csv_out)) {
  write_csv(table_ms, csv_out)
}

print(table_ms)
print(summary_text)
print(p)
```
